sentences.text: This application under Section 430(1) of the Bharathiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/accused in S.C.No.1285 of 2022 on the file of the Court of Session, Malappuram.

The applicant/accused has been convicted and sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the offences punishable under Sections 354D(1), 366, 376(2)(n),
384, 450 and 506(I) IPC.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
Therefore, the maximum period of imprisonment the applicant/accused will have to undergo is ten years.
2. The learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that as in & per the prosecution case, the first incident took place in the year 2018.
However, the crime was registered after a long delay, that is, only on 27/06/2022.
This is one aspect to doubt the prosecution case.

Though the prosecution has a version that several intimate videos of the victim as well as her relatives were sent to the accused under his threat and intimidation, none of the said evidence has been produced before the Court.
It is also pointed out that the victim/survivor in this case is a 31 year old married woman with two children whereas the applicant/accused was only 27 years at the time of the incident.
3. The application is opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor who submits that sexual abuse took place for a period of about 4 years, that is, from 2018 to 2022.
The crime was registered in 2022 and hence there is no inordinate delay in registering the crime.

It is also submitted that it was because the applicant/accused threatened the victim, she was forced to send him the intimate videos of herself as well as her relatives.
4. Heard both sides.

in &
5.

On going through the impugned judgment, I find that the first instance took place on 15/05/2018 when the accused is alleged to have invited the victim to a tourist home in Edavanna, at which place he is alleged to have raped the latter.

What prompted or persuaded the victim, a married woman to proceed to the said tourist home at the request of the applicant/accused with whom she got acquainted with on the basis of a single telephone call has not been explained by the prosecution.
Therefore, there is likelihood or probability of the relationship having been consensual, as submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused.
The applicant/accused appears to have a good arguable case.
The appeal is of the year 2024 and so there is no likelihood of the appeal being taken up in the near future.
